Yes, the 610 record-access duties apply to contract fillers when the brand owner is the responsible person, because § 610(a) applies to each responsible person and facility, and if the brand owner is listed on the label as the responsible person under § 604(4), then that person and any facility involved in manufacturing or processing cosmetics are subject to record access requirements [1].  

The record-access duties under FD&C Act § 610(a) apply to each responsible person and facility when the Secretary has a reasonable belief that a cosmetic product is likely to be adulterated in a manner posing a threat of serious adverse health consequences or death [1].  

The record-access duties do not extend to recipes or formulas, financial data, pricing data, personnel data (other than data on qualification of technical and professional personnel), research data (except safety substantiation data for cosmetics and ingredients), or sales data (except shipment data regarding sales) [1].  

The record-access duty applies only if the Secretary has a reasonable belief that a cosmetic product is likely to be adulterated and poses a threat of serious adverse health consequences or death; otherwise, no access is required under § 610(a) [1].  

The record-access duty applies to any facility that manufactures or processes cosmetic products, including contract fillers engaged in such activities, as long as they are not excluded by § 604(3)(B), which excludes entities performing only labeling, relabeling, packaging, repackaging, holding, or distributing without manufacturing or processing [1].  

The record-access duty does not apply to a facility that solely performs one or more of the following: labeling, relabeling, packaging, repackaging, holding, or distributing—unless such activities are part of a larger process involving manufacture or processing of cosmetic products [1].  

These provisions do not require any specific retention period for records beyond what is necessary to assist the Secretary in determining adulteration [1].
